product_form.notes: The 110 x 110 x 5 mm dimensions describe the nominal Hostatron mold, not a measured final density-coupon size.

processing.text: Thermo Haake Rheomix 600 at 50 rpm; Table 2 assigns 70 +/- 1 deg C to EPDM/paraffin foams made with foaming agents. Initial matrix/sulfur/carbon-black/stearic-acid/ZnO mixing 5 min, then TMTD/ZDBC 5 min; Hostatron mixed 5 min, followed by gradual paraffin addition and 20 min compounding.

evidence.locator: v2 PDF pp.4-5 sections 2.2-2.2.2/Tables 2-3, Hostatron foams containing paraffin

processing.notes: Compounding temperature is not the density-test temperature.

temper_or_heat_treatment.text: Closed-mold vulcanization at 170 deg C and initial pressure 1 bar for 10 min; pressure then released to permit expansion, with a further 10 min for vulcanization.

evidence.locator: v2 PDF pp.4-5 sections 2.2-2.2.2/Tables 2-3, Hostatron foams containing paraffin

temper_or_heat_treatment.notes: The Hostatron mold is nominally 110 x 110 x 5 mm. Do not transfer the unfoamed reference pressure of 8 bar.

conditioning.notes: Density-specific post-cure conditioning, humidity and waiting interval are not reported.

composition_or_purity.text: Vistalon 2504 EPDM 100 phr; sulfur 3.00 phr; zinc oxide 3.00 phr; stearic acid 1.00 phr; N550 carbon black 20.00 phr; TMTD 0.87 phr; ZDBC 2.50 phr; Hostatron P0168 1.3 phr; Rubitherm RT70HC paraffin 33.0 phr. Table 3 nominal RT70HC label 20.0 wt% (not a measured final mass fraction); source also prints 22.0 vv%. No Micropearl, NaCl or PEG is added in the selected recipe.

evidence.locator: v2 PDF p.3 section 2.1/Table 1 and p.5 Table 3, Hostatron/paraffin formulations, EPDM_H_P20 row

composition_or_purity.notes: Table 3 presents RT70HC columns in phr, wt% and vv%, whereas section 2.2 describes the nominal PCM percentages with respect to the EPDM compound and the sample-code paragraph describes percentage in the sample. These are distinct source representations with an unresolved percentage-denominator scope; the stated percentages are not percentages per 100 parts of raw EPDM. Preserve the printed phr and nominal wt% separately without conversion, renormalization or a measured final-composition claim. The final cured composition and residual blowing-agent products were not assayed in the selected passages.

reinforcement.text: 20.00 phr N550 carbon black in the EPDM base compound

evidence.locator: v2 PDF p.3 section 2.1/Table 1

reinforcement.notes: RT70HC is the selected phase-change addition; a load-bearing reinforcement function is not inferred for it.

porosity.notes: The source reports derived porosity, but no numerical porosity is admitted because the theoretical density input has an unresolved discrepancy. Foam preparation alone does not establish a quantitative void fraction.

orientation.notes: No material-axis claim is attached to this scalar density; this does not establish isotropy.

records.source_scope: Specific carbon-black-filled EPDM/paraffin study formulation EPDM_H_P20 using 33.0 phr RT70HC and 1.3 phr Hostatron P0168 with the Table 1 compound. The three selected identities differ in paraffin recipe amount, not specimen repetition, temperature, porosity or production-method labels. These are source-qualified prepared composites, not pure EPDM, supplier raw polymer or a certified finished-product grade. The nominal 20 wt% label is retained separately from phr; no cured-composition normalization is inferred. Only measured geometrical density is selected. Ten specimens are method replicates, not ten identities. The 23.0 deg C, 0.2 g and sixty repetitions describe helium pycnometry and are not assigned to this property. Source theoretical rho_bulk and derived porosity are excluded, as is conversion of finite-strain density-normalized E* to Young's modulus.
